cues.en: Mike: All right, now we are ready to learn about the two-Way ANOVA, so a two-factor ANOVA.
cues.zh: Mike：現在準備好學習雙因子 ANOVA，也就是有兩個因子的 ANOVA。

cues.en: You will see that the formulas, all the math, is really similar to the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 你會看到，公式與全部數學都非常類似單因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: It's all conceptually the same.
cues.zh: 概念完全相同。

cues.en: We need to make a few minor adjustments here and there.
cues.zh: 只需要在幾個地方稍作調整。

cues.en: And I'm also going to show you in this video how to interpret the main effects and the interactions in a multi-way ANOVA, or a factorial ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這支影片也會示範，如何解讀多因子 ANOVA，也就是因子設計 ANOVA 中的主效應與交互作用。

cues.en: Okay, so let me start by giving an example.
cues.zh: 先舉個例子。

cues.en: Let's say we are looking at factors medication and age, and the levels are medication A, medication B, and placebo.
cues.zh: 假設研究藥物與年齡因子，水準是藥物 A、藥物 B 與安慰劑。

cues.en: so these would be the levels within the medication factor, and younger versus older would be the levels within the age factor.
cues.zh: 這些是藥物因子的水準，年輕與年長則是年齡因子的水準。

cues.en: This is exactly an example I gave in one of the videos in the beginning of this section.
cues.zh: 這與本單元前幾支影片舉的例子完全相同。

cues.en: It's just to remind you of what a two-factor ANOVA would look like.
cues.zh: 只是提醒雙因子 ANOVA 會是什麼樣子。

cues.en: So this would be the table that we produce to represent our data and represent the design of the experiment.
cues.zh: 這就是用來表示資料與實驗設計的表格。

cues.en: Okay, so a two-way ANOVA still involves partitioning up the sum of squares of the total variance in exactly the same way
cues.zh: 雙因子 ANOVA 同樣要分割總變異的平方和，方式與

cues.en: as the one-way ANOVA, it's just that we have more factors to worry about.
cues.zh: 單因子 ANOVA 完全相同，只是需要考慮更多因子。

cues.en: So this blue text here, this is repeated from what I wrote earlier with the one sample, or the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 藍色文字重複了先前單樣本，或者說單因子 ANOVA 的說明。

cues.en: So the total variation in the dataset is the sum of the variation across individuals within each group and the variation across the different levels,
cues.zh: 資料集的總變異，是各組內個體之間的變異，加上不同水準之間的變異，

cues.en: and here's the new part, within each factor and the variation at the interaction between the factors.
cues.zh: 新的部分是，各因子內的變異，以及因子交互作用的變異。

cues.en: What is this interaction?
cues.zh: 交互作用是什麼？

cues.en: What does it mean for two factors to have an interaction?
cues.zh: 兩個因子有交互作用，是什麼意思？

cues.en: Well, it means that the effect of one factor depends on the levels of the other factor.
cues.zh: 表示一個因子的效果，取決於另一個因子的水準。

cues.en: So going back to our example here, if the way that the medication works differs depending on whether you're young or old, that is an interaction.
cues.zh: 回到例子，如果藥物效果會因為年輕或年長而不同，就是交互作用。

cues.en: If the medication works exactly the same way regardless of your age, that is no interaction.
cues.zh: 如果不論年齡，藥物都以完全相同的方式作用，就沒有交互作用。

cues.en: So here you see all of the adjustments to the sum of square's formulas for a two-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這裡是雙因子 ANOVA 的平方和公式所需的全部調整。

cues.en: Now, I know it looks like a lot, there's an awful lot of sigmas and colors and the font is really small and everything, but don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 我知道看起來很多，有大量求和符號、顏色，字又很小，但不用擔心。

cues.en: I am going to walk you through all of this and you will see that it's actually pretty comprehensible.
cues.zh: 會一步步帶你看，你會發現其實很好理解。

cues.en: It's not so bad.
cues.zh: 沒有那麼糟。

cues.en: So let's start off with the sum of squares total.
cues.zh: 從總平方和開始。

cues.en: Now, this is exactly the same concept as the sum of squares that you learned about before for the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 概念與先前單因子 ANOVA 學到的總平方和完全相同。

cues.en: And in fact, it's really just the total variance of the dataset.
cues.zh: 其實就是資料集的總變異。

cues.en: In fact, when you compute the mean square total, you're dividing the SS total by the degrees of freedom for the total, and that's really just literally the variance
cues.zh: 計算總均方時，把總 SS 除以總自由度，實際上就精確得到

cues.en: over the entire dataset.
cues.zh: 整份資料集的變異數。

cues.en: It looks a little bit confusing here with the triple summation sign, but that's just to emphasize the fact that individuals are embedded inside our two factors,
cues.zh: 三重求和符號看起來有點混亂，但只是要強調，個體嵌在兩個因子之內，

cues.en: in this case, two factors, I call them factor A and factor B.
cues.zh: 這裡的兩個因子稱為 A 與 B。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the same term as for the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 所以這一項與單因子 ANOVA 相同。

cues.en: And then here we have two SS between terms.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個組間 SS 項。

cues.en: Now, with the one-way ANOVA, we add only one term for sum of squares between.
cues.zh: 單因子 ANOVA 只有一個組間平方和項。

cues.en: Here, we have two because, well, we have two factors in our design, factor A and factor B.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個，因為設計中有 A 與 B 兩個因子。

cues.en: And if you had three factors in your experiment, you would do a three-way ANOVA, and then you would have three terms for SS between for each factor, and so on.
cues.zh: 如果實驗有三個因子，就做三因子 ANOVA，並對每個因子各有一個組間 SS 項，共三個，依此類推。

cues.en: Now, most of this formula should look pretty familiar from the one-way ANOVA, and it's basically the same, we are still subtracting the mean of each level,
cues.zh: 大部分公式應該很熟悉，與單因子 ANOVA 基本上相同，仍然是減去各水準的平均值，

cues.en: so no individuals in here, it's the mean of each level minus the total mean.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有個體，是各水準平均值減去總平均值。

cues.en: So that means that we are computing the variance when we get, when we divide by the degrees of freedom, we are computing the variance of this factor.
cues.zh: 因此，除以自由度之後，就是計算這個因子的變異數。

cues.en: So the variability of the levels across this factor, ignoring the individual data observations within each level, or sorry, within each factor across the different levels.
cues.zh: 也就是跨這個因子水準的變異，忽略各水準內的個別觀察，或者說，忽略各因子不同水準內的個體。

cues.en: Now you have to be a little bit mindful here because, let me go back to this table here.
cues.zh: 這裡要稍微注意，回到這張表。

cues.en: So for SS between, we are ignoring one of the factors.
cues.zh: 計算組間 SS 時，會忽略其中一個因子。

cues.en: So we pull these two cells together and we pull these two cells and these two cells together and so on.
cues.zh: 把這兩格合併、這兩格合併、這兩格也合併，依此類推。

cues.en: So it's like we're computing the marginal variance ignoring one factor.
cues.zh: 就像忽略一個因子，計算邊際變異數。

cues.en: So we pull across the columns for one factor, we pull across the rows for the other factor.
cues.zh: 對一個因子，跨欄合併；另一個因子，則跨列合併。

cues.en: Now, there is one small adjustment in these two formulas here, one little addition which is not present in the sum of squares between in the one-way ANOVA,
cues.zh: 這兩個公式有個小調整、多了一點東西，是單因子 ANOVA 的組間平方和沒有的，

cues.en: and that is this multiplicative factor here, this multiplication here, by B and little N.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的乘法因子，乘上 B 與小寫 n。

cues.en: So this is not big N, which is the total number of observations, or the total number of research participants, all of the data observations that we have, this is a small N here.
cues.zh: 不是大寫 N，那是觀察總數、研究參與者總數、所有資料觀察數；這裡是小寫 n。

cues.en: So we multiply by BN, this is SS between for factor A, we multiply by BN, where N is the number of observations
cues.zh: 計算因子 A 的組間 SS，乘上 Bn，n 是觀察數，

cues.en: in each level of factor B, and B here is the number of levels in factor B.
cues.zh: 在因子 B 的各個水準內的觀察數，而 B 是因子 B 的水準數。

cues.en: And then here for SS between, B, for factor B, we multiply by N.
cues.zh: 這裡因子 B 的組間 SS，也乘以 n。

cues.en: Again, N is the total number of observations in each level, within each level, of factor A.
cues.zh: n 同樣是因子 A 各個水準內的觀察總數。

cues.en: And little A is the total number of levels within factor A.
cues.zh: 小寫 a 則是因子 A 的水準總數。

cues.en: So basically, BN and AN are the total number of observations of the other factor.
cues.zh: 基本上，Bn 與 An 是另一個因子的觀察總數。

cues.en: Now, that might seem backwards, it might look like, you might think I made a typo here and that these two terms are swapped, but actually this does make sense.
cues.zh: 這可能看起來反了，你也許認為我打錯字，把兩項交換了，但其實合理。

cues.en: This is actually correct.
cues.zh: 這確實正確。

cues.en: So the thing is that when we compute SS between A, we're aggregating over the levels of factor B, and here, we are aggregating over the levels of factor A.
cues.zh: 因為計算組間 SS A 時，我們跨因子 B 的水準彙整；這裡則跨因子 A 的水準彙整。

cues.en: So let's say, for example, let's pretend that factor B has 10 levels, whereas factor A only has two levels.
cues.zh: 例如，假設因子 B 有 10 個水準，因子 A 只有兩個。

cues.en: In that case, we can actually expect that SS A is going to be larger, it's gonna be higher than SS B, simply because B has more levels,
cues.zh: 這種情況，可能預期 SS A 會比 SS B 大，只因為 B 的水準較多，

cues.en: so we're aggregating across more levels of factor B.
cues.zh: 所以是跨因子 B 的更多水準彙整。

cues.en: So therefore, multiplying by the number of levels of the other factor accounts for a possible difference between the number of levels in the different factors.
cues.zh: 因此，乘以另一因子的水準數，可以考量不同因子之間可能存在的水準數差異。

cues.en: Okay, so that's for SS between, then we get to here, this interaction term.
cues.zh: 這是組間 SS，接著是這個交互作用項。

cues.en: So this is SS A times B, or A cross B, this is the interaction between A and B.
cues.zh: 這是 SS A 乘 B，或 A 交叉 B，表示 A 與 B 的交互作用。

cues.en: Now, this formula looks a little bit weirder, and this entire term doesn't even exist for one-way ANOVA, obviously, because there are no multiple factors
cues.zh: 這個公式看起來更奇怪，而且單因子 ANOVA 根本沒有這整項，因為顯然，

cues.en: in a one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 單因子 ANOVA 沒有多個因子。

cues.en: Okay, so this equation is new, but the principle is the same, it's still the sum of squared errors, and that's a measure of variability that we can attribute
cues.zh: 所以這是新方程式，但原理相同，仍然是平方誤差總和，用來衡量能歸因於

cues.en: to the factors interacting with each other.
cues.zh: 因子彼此交互作用的變異。

cues.en: Okay, so how does this work?
cues.zh: 它怎麼運作？

cues.en: Well, essentially, we are taking the individual cell mean and then subtracting off the marginal mean from factor B, the marginal mean from factor A, within each level,
cues.zh: 基本上，取個別格子的平均值，再減去因子 B 與因子 A 在各水準的邊際平均值，

cues.en: and then we add back onto this the total mean across the entire dataset, so the mean from the entire data table.
cues.zh: 最後加回整份資料集的總平均值，也就是整張資料表的平均值。

cues.en: Now, it may seem odd that we are adding back the grand average and not subtracting, but that's actually just how the algebra works out from computing this term here.
cues.zh: 加回總平均值，而不是減去，可能很奇怪，但這只是計算這一項時，代數運算的結果。

cues.en: I don't wanna focus on that too much, but I will briefly explain it just so it doesn't seem so mysterious and complicated.
cues.zh: 不想花太多時間，但簡短說明，免得看起來太神祕、複雜。

cues.en: So, another way to write out this term here, this interaction term, is as the sum of squares for each cell minus the sum of squares between factor A
cues.zh: 這個交互作用項的另一種寫法，是各格的平方和，減去因子 A 的組間平方和，

cues.en: and minus the sum of squares for between factor B.
cues.zh: 再減去因子 B 的組間平方和。

cues.en: Now, I haven't actually defined this term formally, but it's essentially just this term here minus the grand mean.
cues.zh: 我還沒正式定義這一項，但基本上就是這一項減去總平均值。

cues.en: So this term, SS L, would look something like this, the formula would look something like this, but it would be X-bar KJ minus the grand mean.
cues.zh: 這個 SS L 的公式會像這樣，但使用 X 平均值下標 kj，減去總平均值。

cues.en: Okay, so this is like the interaction, and then we subtract off the variability attributable to either factor alone.
cues.zh: 這就像交互作用，再減去可單獨歸因於任一因子的變異。

cues.en: So all three of these terms here involves subtracting the total mean, so X-bar, so you get this term is positive
cues.zh: 這三項都涉及減去總平均值，也就是 X 平均值，因此這一項為正，

cues.en: and these two terms are negative.
cues.zh: 這兩項為負。

cues.en: So we have, in this case, minus an X-bar for SS L and then minus a minus X-bar, and then minus a minus x-bar.
cues.zh: 這裡 SS L 有一個負 X 平均值，再減去負 X 平均值，再減去負 X 平均值。

cues.en: So you get the double negatives here.
cues.zh: 於是出現雙重負號。

cues.en: These X-bars end up being positive, so here you get minus X-bar plus X-bar plus X-bar, the minus X-bar cancels with one of the plus X-bars, and you end up with one X--bar.
cues.zh: 這些 X 平均值變正，所以得到負 X 平均值，加 X 平均值，再加 X 平均值；負的與其中一個正的抵消，剩下一個 X 平均值。

cues.en: So okay, yeah, (chuckles) if that's a little confusing, don't worry about it.
cues.zh: 如果覺得有點混亂，不用擔心。

cues.en: The point is that there's nothing special about adding the mean, it's really just how the algebra works out when we are subtracting mean-centered data multiple times like this.
cues.zh: 重點是，加上平均值沒有什麼特別，只是這樣多次減去平均中心化資料時，代數運算的結果。

cues.en: Okay, anyway, and then finally, we have the SS within down here, which is also sometimes called the sum of squared errors, sometimes also called the error term.
cues.zh: 最後是下面的組內 SS，也有時稱為誤差平方和，或誤差項。

cues.en: Now this is also exactly the same concept as we had in the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 與單因子 ANOVA 的概念完全相同。

cues.en: So we're still subtracting individuals from their mean, and then we compute the variance.
cues.zh: 仍然是個體值與其平均值相減，再計算變異數。

cues.en: And the key difference is that here we have the mean of each cell instead of the mean of the entire dataset up here.
cues.zh: 關鍵差異是，這裡是各格的平均值，而不是上面的整份資料集平均值。

cues.en: Okay, so this is really just all of the variances within each cell pooled together.
cues.zh: 其實就是把各格內的所有變異合併。

cues.en: So there you go, the fairly complicated-looking table for two-way ANOVA, but I hope you can appreciate that the equations look complicated,
cues.zh: 這是一張看起來相當複雜的雙因子 ANOVA 公式表，但希望你能理解，公式雖複雜，

cues.en: but the concepts are just a fairly straightforward extension from the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 概念卻只是單因子 ANOVA 相當直接的延伸。

cues.en: So here we have the ANOVA table for a two-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 這是雙因子 ANOVA 的 ANOVA 表。

cues.en: This is a factorial ANOVA with two factors.
cues.zh: 也就是有兩個因子的因子設計 ANOVA。

cues.en: So it's the same exact concept that you saw for the one-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 與單因子 ANOVA 的概念完全相同。

cues.en: We have the sum of squares, we have the degrees of freedom, the mean square, and the F, which is just the ratios of the mean square to the within,
cues.zh: 有平方和、自由度、均方與 F，F 就是均方與組內均方的比值，

cues.en: the mean square for each factor and the interaction terms divided by the mean square for within.
cues.zh: 也就是各因子與交互作用項的均方，除以組內均方。

cues.en: And now, of course, we have a separate P-value.
cues.zh: 現在當然有各自的 P 值。

cues.en: We have a P-value for each individual factor here and each interaction term.
cues.zh: 每個個別因子，以及每個交互作用項，都有 P 值。

cues.en: But importantly, the interpretation of this P-value is exactly the same.
cues.zh: 但重要的是，P 值的解讀完全相同。

cues.en: So, this P value tells us that at least one level of factor B is significantly different from at least one other factor in level B.
cues.zh: 這個 P 值告訴我們，因子 B 至少一個水準，與因子 B 至少另一個水準有顯著差異。

cues.en: Now, this P-value doesn't tell us anything about factor A, and this P-value doesn't tell us anything about the, or this P-value doesn't tell us anything
cues.zh: 這個 P 值不會告訴我們因子 A 的任何資訊，也不會告訴我們，或者說，這個 P 值不會告訴我們

cues.en: about the interaction term.
cues.zh: 交互作用項的資訊。

cues.en: So each P-value is only telling us about that specific factor.
cues.zh: 每個 P 值都只說明那個特定因子。

cues.en: Again, determining which groups differ from which require data visualization and follow up post-hoc t-test comparisons.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，要確定哪些群組彼此不同，需要視覺化資料，以及後續的事後 t 檢定比較。

cues.en: All right, so what is the important take-home message from this?
cues.zh: 這裡最重要的重點是什麼？

cues.en: Well, I would say never ever compute an ANOVA by hand.
cues.zh: 我會說，絕對不要手算 ANOVA。

cues.en: God, what a nightmare that would be.
cues.zh: 天啊，那會是噩夢。

cues.en: So that's enough math for now.
cues.zh: 數學先到這裡。

cues.en: What I would like to do is discuss a little bit more how exactly to interpret a significant main effect, and importantly, how to interpret a significant interaction.
cues.zh: 接著想多談一點，究竟如何解讀顯著主效應，尤其如何解讀顯著交互作用。

cues.en: And to do that, I'm going to visualize a couple of different possible outcomes that we can get from an ANOVA.
cues.zh: 我會把 ANOVA 可能得到的幾種結果視覺化。

cues.en: So I'm gonna simplify things a little bit and make it a two-factor and also two-level ANOVA.
cues.zh: 稍微簡化，使用兩個因子，而且各有兩個水準的 ANOVA。

cues.en: So this is going to be an experiment where we study the effects of vitamin supplements versus placebo on an age group, so 30 to 40 year olds versus 50 to 60 year olds,
cues.zh: 實驗研究維他命補充劑與安慰劑，在不同年齡組別，也就是 30 到 40 歲與 50 到 60 歲，

cues.en: on cardiovascular health.
cues.zh: 對心血管健康的影響。

cues.en: So we wanna know does this particular vitamin supplement improve cardiovascular health, and does that depend on the age of the research participants,
cues.zh: 想知道這種維他命補充劑，是否改善心血管健康，以及效果是否取決於研究參與者，

cues.en: the volunteers, or whatever?
cues.zh: 或志願者的年齡。

cues.en: So pretty clinically relevant and socially relevant experiment that we can run here.
cues.zh: 這是相當具有臨床與社會意義的實驗。

cues.en: Here's our experiment design table.
cues.zh: 這是實驗設計表。

cues.en: So we have two factors, the vitamin supplement versus placebo and the age group, the young versus the old.
cues.zh: 兩個因子是維他命補充劑相對於安慰劑，以及年齡組別，年輕相對於年長。

cues.en: And I'm just putting Xs here as placeholders.
cues.zh: 這裡只是用 X 當占位符號。

cues.en: Okay, so, of course, made up data, as always.
cues.zh: 當然，一如往常，資料都是編的。

cues.en: So what I'm gonna show you is three different graphs that highlight different possible outcomes that we can get from the ANOVA table.
cues.zh: 要展示三張不同圖，凸顯 ANOVA 表可能呈現的不同結果。

cues.en: So in this case, this is, well, so this is cardiovascular health on the Y-axis.
cues.zh: 這裡 Y 軸是心血管健康。

cues.en: Here we have the groups.
cues.zh: 這裡是群組。

cues.en: And in the the paired bars, the colors correspond to whether it's the placebo or the actual vitamin supplement.
cues.zh: 成對長條的顏色，對應安慰劑或真正的維他命補充劑。

cues.en: Okay, so in this case, we see a main effect of age, no effect of, no main effect of medication, and no interaction between these two terms.
cues.zh: 這種情況有年齡主效應、沒有藥物主效應，也沒有兩者的交互作用。

cues.en: So what do these things mean?
cues.zh: 這些是什麼意思？

cues.en: The main effect of age means that we only look at the age, we completely ignore the medication, so the average of these two groups
cues.zh: 年齡主效應表示，只看年齡，完全忽略藥物，也就是這兩組的平均，

cues.en: versus the average of these two groups.
cues.zh: 相對於那兩組的平均。

cues.en: So young people have, on average, better cardiovascular health than old people, okay?
cues.zh: 平均而言，年輕人的心血管健康比年長者好。

cues.en: No big shocker there.
cues.zh: 這不太令人驚訝。

cues.en: The main effect of medication means we look at the medication ignoring the age group.
cues.zh: 藥物主效應，則是忽略年齡組別，只看藥物。

cues.en: So the average of these green bars here is gonna be somewhere around here, and the average of these blue bars here is also gonna be somewhere around here.
cues.zh: 這些綠色長條的平均大概在這裡，這些藍色長條的平均也大概在這裡。

cues.en: So, on average, when ignoring age, medication has no effect relative to placebo.
cues.zh: 因此，平均而言，忽略年齡時，藥物相對於安慰劑沒有效果。

cues.en: And there's also no interaction because the effect of medication, or the vitamin supplement, doesn't depend on the age group.
cues.zh: 也沒有交互作用，因為藥物或維他命補充劑的效果，不取決於年齡組別。

cues.en: Okay, so that's one possible outcome that we could get.
cues.zh: 這是一種可能結果。

cues.en: Here's another one.
cues.zh: 這是另一種。

cues.en: We have a significant effect of age, a significant main effect of the medication, and a significant interaction between 'em.
cues.zh: 年齡效果顯著、藥物主效應顯著，兩者的交互作用也顯著。

cues.en: So let's go through each one of these three.
cues.zh: 逐一看這三個。

cues.en: So the main effect of age, we interpret the same way as we do before.
cues.zh: 年齡主效應的解讀，與先前相同。

cues.en: You see the average of these two bars is higher than the average of these two bars.
cues.zh: 這兩條的平均，高於那兩條的平均。

cues.en: So young people have better cardiovascular health.
cues.zh: 因此，年輕人的心血管健康較好。

cues.en: Okay, then we see the main effect of medication is statistically significant.
cues.zh: 接著，藥物主效應達到統計顯著。

cues.en: So how do we interpret that?
cues.zh: 該如何解讀？

cues.en: Well, what that's telling us is that the average of these two bars, which is the medication, is higher than the average of these two bars, the blue bars,
cues.zh: 它表示這兩條，也就是藥物組的平均，高於另外這兩條藍色長條的平均，

cues.en: which is the effect of placebo.
cues.zh: 也就是安慰劑的效果。

cues.en: So the average of the blue bars, ignoring age, is lower than the average of these two bars.
cues.zh: 所以忽略年齡，藍色長條的平均，低於這兩條的平均。

cues.en: Now, I can imagine that your face is crumpling up and you're giving your computer a quizzical look because you're not really sure if that's an appropriate way
cues.zh: 我想像你現在皺起臉，疑惑地看著電腦，因為不太確定這樣

cues.en: to interpret this main effect of medication.
cues.zh: 解讀藥物主效應是否合適。

cues.en: Well, and you're right to question this, you're right to be suspicious of this.
cues.zh: 你質疑得對，有理由懷疑。

cues.en: There is a significant interaction term here and the interaction term is telling us that the medication has no effect on young people
cues.zh: 這裡有顯著交互作用，表示藥物對年輕人沒有效果，

cues.en: and a significant effect on old people.
cues.zh: 對年長者則有效果，而且顯著。

cues.en: So this is a real effect.
cues.zh: 這是真實的效果。

cues.en: The old people are really benefiting from the medication and the young people are not benefiting at all, relative to placebo.
cues.zh: 相對於安慰劑，年長者確實受益，年輕人則完全沒有受益。

cues.en: So, now, here's the important message from this middle panel here.
cues.zh: 中間這張圖的重要訊息是：

cues.en: When you have a significant interaction term in your ANOVA, you have to be careful about interpreting the main effects.
cues.zh: ANOVA 有顯著交互作用項時，解讀主效應必須小心。

cues.en: The main effects could be significant, but still difficult to interpret.
cues.zh: 主效應可能顯著，但仍難以解讀。

cues.en: So in this case, we actually see both examples, or both ways that this could work out.
cues.zh: 這裡其實同時看到兩種例子、兩種可能情況。

cues.en: So, the main effect of age is still interpretable even though there is an interaction with medication.
cues.zh: 雖然年齡與藥物有交互作用，但年齡主效應仍可解讀。

cues.en: So young people have better cardiovascular health than old people.
cues.zh: 年輕人的心血管健康比年長者好。

cues.en: That's true with or without the medication.
cues.zh: 不論有沒有藥物，都成立。

cues.en: But the effect of, so the main effect of medication, I don't think that that is a main effect that we should really interpret.
cues.zh: 但藥物主效應，我認為不太應該去解讀。

cues.en: So this main effect is clouded by the significant interaction.
cues.zh: 它被顯著交互作用所遮蔽。

cues.en: So when you have a significant interaction term, it doesn't mean that the main effects are not interpretable, it just means you have to be careful and look at the results carefully
cues.zh: 因此，有顯著交互作用項，不代表主效應一定不能解讀，而是要小心、仔細看結果，

cues.en: and decide for yourself whether it makes sense to interpret the main effects or not.
cues.zh: 自行判斷解讀主效應是否合理。

cues.en: Okay, here is another example of a pattern of results that we can get.
cues.zh: 這裡是另一種可能的結果模式。

cues.en: So here we have a main effect of age, no main effect, no significant main effect of medication, and a significant interaction.
cues.zh: 有年齡主效應、沒有顯著藥物主效應，但有顯著交互作用。

cues.en: And we see what's going on here, the young people are actually hurt by the medication.
cues.zh: 可以看到，藥物其實傷害了年輕人。

cues.en: So, I don't know if that makes sense or not, but that's just to illustrate the possibilities here.
cues.zh: 我不知道這合不合理，只是示範可能性。

cues.en: So the young people are actually doing worse, they get less healthy when they take this vitamin supplement, whereas the old people are getting more healthy from this supplement.
cues.zh: 年輕人服用這個維他命補充劑後，健康反而變差；年長者則因此更健康。

cues.en: So let's walk through these again.
cues.zh: 再逐一檢視。

cues.en: So the main effect of age tells us that the average of these two bars is higher than the average of these two bars.
cues.zh: 年齡主效應表示，這兩條的平均高於那兩條。

cues.en: So that still makes sense.
cues.zh: 仍然合理。

cues.en: That's still interpretable.
cues.zh: 仍然可以解讀。

cues.en: Now, this may seem weird because there's no effect of medication, but this is actually no main effect of medication.
cues.zh: 沒有藥物效果可能很奇怪，但實際上是沒有藥物「主效應」。

cues.en: And so, the way we interpret this lack of main effect of medication is that the average of these green bars is around here
cues.zh: 沒有藥物主效應的解讀，是綠色長條平均在這附近，

cues.en: and the average of these blue bars is around here.
cues.zh: 藍色長條平均也在這附近。

cues.en: So in fact, if you would just ignore age, if you ignored the factor of age altogether and pulled the two ages together, you would find
cues.zh: 如果完全忽略年齡，把兩組年齡合併，會發現

cues.en: that there is no main effect of the medication.
cues.zh: 藥物沒有主效應。

cues.en: But that's because there is this significant interaction term, so the medication is making some people worse and some people better.
cues.zh: 但這是因為有顯著交互作用，藥物讓一些人變差、另一些人變好。

cues.en: So we get this interaction term.
cues.zh: 所以得到這個交互作用項。

cues.en: So we have a couple of important conclusions that we can learn here, a couple of take-home messages.
cues.zh: 這裡可以得到幾個重要結論。

cues.en: Take-home message number one is that main effects must be interpreted cautiously, carefully when there is a significant interaction term involving that factor.
cues.zh: 第一，若有涉及某個因子的顯著交互作用，必須審慎、小心地解讀其主效應。

cues.en: Again, a significant interaction term doesn't mean that you cannot interpret the main effects, like we saw in this case with age, but it does mean that you have to look at the data carefully
cues.zh: 再次提醒，顯著交互作用不代表主效應不能解讀，就像這裡的年齡例子，但必須仔細看資料，

cues.en: and decide whether that main effect is interpretable.
cues.zh: 決定那個主效應能不能解讀。

cues.en: By the way, this here, this is called a crossover interaction, when the effect of one factor changes direction based on the levels of the other factor.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這稱為交叉交互作用，表示一個因子的效果，會隨另一因子的水準改變方向。

cues.en: You can see why they call it a crossover interaction it's almost making an X-like pattern here.
cues.zh: 可以看出為什麼稱為交叉，這裡幾乎形成 X 的形狀。

cues.en: So crossover interaction.
cues.zh: 所以叫交叉交互作用。

cues.en: Okay, and another more general take-home message, which is actually not specific to this slide, but just sort of a general principle and statistics, you always have to visualize your data
cues.zh: 另一個更普遍的重點，不只針對這張投影片，而是統計的一般原則：一定要把資料視覺化，

cues.en: to interpret the data properly.
cues.zh: 才能正確解讀。

cues.en: Data must always be visualized.
cues.zh: 資料一定要視覺化。

cues.en: That is true whether you have a significant effect or a non-significant effect.
cues.zh: 不論效果顯著或不顯著，都一樣。

cues.en: It's always important to visualize your data, or at least report the means in a table.
cues.zh: 資料視覺化總是重要，或至少在表格中報告平均值。

cues.en: You don't necessarily always have to visualize in bar charts and lines and histograms.
cues.zh: 不一定非得用長條圖、折線圖與直方圖。

cues.en: You can also, if it's a pretty simple set of data, you can just report the means in a table that might be sufficient.
cues.zh: 如果資料很簡單，也可以只在表格報告平均值，可能就足夠。

cues.en: So that was a pretty productive video.
cues.zh: 這支影片很有收穫。

cues.en: You learned how to extend the one-way ANOVA into a two-way ANOVA.
cues.zh: 你學會如何把單因子 ANOVA 延伸成雙因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: Now, I'm not going to tell you about the three-way ANOVA because it's like, just, it just starts getting ridiculous.
cues.zh: 不會再介紹三因子 ANOVA，因為那開始有點誇張。

cues.en: We start getting a lot of formulas, they all look really similar, they all start looking the same.
cues.zh: 公式愈來愈多，看起來都很類似，最後都像同樣的東西。

cues.en: You understand now the principle, and the principle applies to a 17-way ANOVA with all possible interaction terms.
cues.zh: 你現在已理解原理，而它同樣適用於包含所有可能交互作用的 17 因子 ANOVA。

cues.en: Things get really hairy when you get more than, three factors is possible, but when you start to get, when the ANOVA tables start getting more complicated, things get hairier,
cues.zh: 超過——三個因子還可以，但當 ANOVA 表開始更加複雜，事情就愈來愈棘手，

cues.en: the formulas themselves get to be a bit thicker, but the fundamental principle is exactly the same, and that you already know about.
cues.zh: 公式本身也愈來愈繁複，但基本原理完全相同，而你已經知道了。
